📌 सूत्र: बाएँ से स्थान + दाएँ से स्थान = कुल व्यक्ति + 1। महेश का पुराना स्थान (दाएँ से 24वाँ) यहाँ अनावश्यक जानकारी है।

N39318.expe:
✔ After swapping, Mahesh takes Anil's place (32nd from the left). Position from the right = total − position from left + 1 = 47 − 32 + 1 = 16th.
📌 Rule: position from left + position from right = total + 1. Mahesh's old position (24th from the right) is extra information here.
✖ 15th — forgetting to add 1 (total − left position); 23rd — a number near Mahesh's old position, not calculated; 24th — Mahesh's old position.

N39590.expe:
✔ After swapping, Manoj takes Sohan's place (12th from the left). Position from the right = total − position from left + 1 = 26 − 12 + 1 = 15th.

✖ 14th — forgetting to add 1 (total − left position); 1st — does not fit the formula; 2nd — Manoj's old position from the left.
